notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 115-assertion HLA_EVOKED three-member directed TSO restore case. A timestamp-eight directed passel targeted at one published object remains queued for two constrained subscribers at a completed save. A later post-save passel is retracted and terminalized, then discarded by restore. Each subscriber independently issues Flush Queue Request and receives the saved passel before its own grant, without the first subscriber's FQR releasing the second subscriber's copy. A retraction of the saved designator invokes Request Retraction at both recipients and becomes terminal. C++ primary/contract passed in an isolated executable linked only against the installed 2026-10-20 package with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 object/attribute/directed-interaction FOM, time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance remain unverified.
